summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **1.31%, 0.90%, 0.98%, 2.69%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Prior mixed-precision quantization methods have performed a post-training quantization search, which compromises...；Finally, we extend FLIQS to simultaneously search a joint quantization and neural architecture space and improve...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 6 赞），本工作为突破 **极低比特量化 (FP8/INT4/1.58-bit)** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: From Discrete Tokens to High-Fidelity Audio Using Multi-Band Diffusion
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **From Discrete Tokens to High-Fidelity** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model），并引入 Mel-frequency
Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this work, we propose a high-fidelity multi-band diffusion-based framework that generates any type of audio modality (e.g., speech, music, environmental sounds) from...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Although such methods produce impressive results, they are prone to generate audible artifacts when the conditioning is flawed or imperfect。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（At equal bit rate, the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art generative techniques in terms of perceptual quality）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 5 赞），本工作为突破 **多模态与统一基座** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
